name: Kawasaki H1 Mach III 500
engine: 499 cc air-cooled two-stroke triple, three carbs, oil injection, CDI
intro: The original Kawasaki triple. A fast two-stroke where crank seals and ignition decide everything.

add.title: Check the crank seals
add.instructions: Pressure or vacuum test the crankcase, or plan on new seals. Old seals between the cylinders leak and let the engine run lean.
add.reason: Seals dry out over the decades, and a leaking seal can seize a two-stroke.

add.title: Service the oil injection pump
add.instructions: Bleed the oil injection lines and check the pump cable adjustment so each cylinder gets oil.
add.reason: The engine is lubricated only by the injected oil.

F: Most H1s use CDI ignition. If it cuts out or won't start when hot, suspect the CDI box or coils first.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Worn crank seals
known.what: Seals wear and dry out with age.
